Covers the introduction and every section 30.1-30.7.3 in order (principle of ¹H NMR, deuterated solvents, chemical shift and TMS, Table 30.1, low-resolution spectra, n+1 splitting and Table 30.2, D₂O exchange, predicting and deducing ¹H spectra, ¹³C NMR, Table 30.3, predicting ¹³C spectra and structure from ¹³C). Peak counts, sub-peak counts and peak-area ratios were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: even-even nuclei have paired (not necessarily equal) protons and neutrons, number of peaks = number of environments (not protons), the OCH₂ of the ester is a quartet; the '1,1,2,2-dichloroethane' name is not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
